pages.title: Laying Eggs
pages.text: Only female chickens lay eggs. A hen lays one egg about every in-game day (plus a random 1~3 hours).$(br2)If a qualified rooster is nearby, she lays a $(bold)fertilized egg$(); otherwise she lays a normal egg.

pages.title: Fertilized Eggs
pages.text: Fertilized eggs have a special tooltip. To hatch one, place it on a $(bold)hay block$() that $(bold)cannot see the sky$(). After 1 in-game day (20 minutes), a chick will hatch.

pages.title: Important Notes
pages.text: Normal eggs never hatch when thrown. Fertilized eggs won't hatch if exposed to the sky or not on hay. During incubation, the egg cannot be picked up by normal walking — right-click it to collect it.
